dedupe_keys.name: uarizona campus living lab green stormwater infrastructure micrometeorological data

description: This dataset holds meteorological and micrometeorological measurements from three green stormwater infrastructure sites on the University of Arizona campus in Tucson. Old Main is a native xeriscape rain garden fed mainly by rooftop runoff, Gould Simpson is a resilience garden of legume trees that receives water from two rooftops and surrounding hardscape, and Physics and Atmospheric Sciences is a classic southwest landscape graded for stormwater collection. The records were produced by Vanessa Buzzard, Laura Meredith, Thomas Meixner and colleagues and published on Zenodo from 2024 (version 1.0.4) under CC BY 4.0, with a companion data workflow and an interactive dashboard built with the university's Data Science Institute. Access to the most recent data is by request through a form, and the Zenodo record itself lists no open files. Caveats: three campus sites in an arid climate, data by request, and sensor records need checking for gaps. It supports calibration and validation of green infrastructure water balance and urban heat models in dryland cities; a related record is i-Tree.
